name: Phone Connect
author: Brett
description: Pairs the Phone Connect companion app (phone-connect@1) with this console and sends it work: open a page, show a notification, show an approval prompt, start / stop / ask the audio-output recorder, say a line or listen once. Pairing is a one-time code from Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect claimed on the phone with your own hub sign-in; the phone then holds a device token you can revoke at any time. Approvals shown on the phone are decided only by your own tap there (personOnly): no session, agent, MCP tool, CLI or voice phrase can approve or deny. Every action is reachable four ways: REST /api/plugins/phone-connect/…, MCP phone_connect_*, `axf phone …` and voice (phone.*). Replaces the AmberX app for push, open-url and the recorder.

items.description: Opens an https page on the phone, if the phone's URL policy allows it.

items.description: Shows a notification on the phone (kind fyi, fix or alert, with title, body and url), after the Notifications panel allows it.

items.description: Starts the phone's audio-output recorder. Needs an approvalId from the owner's confirm, and Android asks for consent on the phone.

items.title: The recorder state the phone last reported (ask=1 asks it again)
items.description: The recorder state the phone last reported; ask=1 asks the phone for a fresh one.

items.title: Say a line on the phone (mode say, text) or listen once (mode listen, timeoutSeconds)
items.description: Speaks a line on the phone (mode say, with text) or listens once (mode listen, with timeoutSeconds).

items.description: Queues any phone-connect@1 command (open_url, notify, approval, recorder.*, voice). An approval only shows a prompt on the phone; it never decides.

items.description: Recent commands sent to the phone, each with its acknowledgement and result.
